subject: Logic
title: Whataboutism
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Whataboutism.

hook.text: You criticize a politician's scandal. The reply: what about the other side's scandal? Nothing gets addressed.

buildup.text: Whataboutism deflects criticism by pointing to someone else's wrongdoing instead of addressing the charge.

discovery.text: Soviet propaganda perfected this: every American criticism was met with and what about your racism?

twist.text: Both things can be bad. The deflection works only if we accept that one wrong cancels another.

climax.text: Stay on topic. Acknowledge the deflection and return to the original claim being discussed.

quiz.question: What is whataboutism?
options: Deflecting criticism by pointing to someone else's faults
